items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: They had Willie Pajot. They had Walter Dicku, myself, and Sam Dutre, senior.

ctx.x: Who all was in the band at the bungalow?

They had Willie Pajot. They had Walter Dicku, myself, and Sam Dutre, senior. Not junior, senior. Just four pieces, that's all we had. Can you tell me, did Lizzie Miles used to sing out there or not? Some place to stay in there? Well, Lizzie Miles was singing out there before I ever got out there. Before I got out there. Was that the bungalow or someplace else out there? It was someplace else out there. Not the bungalow. No. She was singing at the... We'll try to see her next week. We'll ask her all about that…
Also, I wonder who was in the Maple Leaf Band. Oh, all the different kinds of things.

items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1961-02-07
items.q: And the band over there was Willie Paggio's on Trumpet.

ctx.x: No, but way back you said you worked in a trio in the Depression?

Oh, I worked at Captain Petona, Fifth Wall Athletic Club. Yeah. Captain Petona used to own that. Mm-hmm. Who was that? And I worked with him over at West End Bungle for Old Man Albert Duboss. Yeah. And the band over there was Willie Paggio's on Trumpet. Mm-hmm. Old Man Sam Dutre, Sr. was on sax. Mm-hmm. Before then, they had Big Iron Lowry. You might have heard talk about him. Oh, yeah. Well, he was working there, and he got kind of sick, and he left. Mm-hmm. So Old Man Sam Dutre, Sr., he took his place, and…
